meta.title: The Sunken Vault
meta.premise: A draconic sorcerer investigates an ancient vault beneath a crossroads tavern whose cellar stones whisper of dragons.
meta.tone: High fantasy mystery and arcane danger

protagonist.name: Vespera
features: Draconic Resilience (Base AC 13 + DEX modifier when unarmored)
abilities: Breath Weapon (Fire 15ft cone; 2d6 fire damage, DEX save DC 13; 1/1 per rest)

npcs.name: Caleb
npcs.notes: Discovered glowing draconic runes beneath his cellar beer barrels.

maps.briefDescription: A bustling waystation perched on the high trade road.

theKick.crisis: Goblin looters have breached the forgotten vault below the wine cellar.

features: Font of Magic (Convert Sorcery Points and spell slots; 2/2 points per long rest)
Metamagic (Twinned Spell, Quickened Spell, Careful Spell, Subtle Spell; 3/3 Sorcery Points)
Magical Guidance (Spend 1 Sorcery Point to reroll a failed ability check)
Elemental Affinity (Add CHA modifier to elemental spell damage & gain resistance)
Arcane Surge (Channel bloodline power to ignore elemental resistance)
Bloodline Conduit (+1 to spell save DC when spending Sorcery Points)
Metamagic (3 options known; 10/10 Sorcery Points per long rest)
High Sorcery (Innate mastery of high-circle bloodline spells)
Origin Focus (Maintain concentration through minor damage)
Draconic Wings (Bonus Action: manifest wings for flying speed equal to walking speed)
Sovereign Arcana (Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects)
Metamagic (4 options known; 17/17 Sorcery Points per long rest)
Draconic Presence (Spend 5 Sorcery Points for 60 ft awe or fear aura; 1/1 per rest)
Sorcerous Restoration (Regain 4 expended Sorcery Points on every short rest)

quests.name: The Cellar Incursion
quests.description: Clear the goblin looters out of the cellar and seal the breached vault door.
